findings.label: Ledger cross-process race
findings.detail: Ledger.append serializes only with a threading.Lock; two processes (looping monitor + CLI/dashboard check) can read the same head and write duplicate indices, permanently breaking verify.py. Add an OS-level file lock (msvcrt.locking / fcntl.flock) around read-head-and-append.

findings.label: Ollama tool allowlist not enforced
findings.detail: Toolbox.dispatch accepts every built-in tool regardless of the config's tools list, so a config without send_email can still send email in ollama mode (and the offline mock ignores tool_schemas entirely). Pass the config's tool names into Toolbox and reject undeclared calls.

findings.label: Whitespace-separated recipients bypass judge
findings.detail: attacks/judge.py parse_recipients splits only on ',' and ';', so 'attacker@evil.example user@company.example' is one token ending in @company.example and is judged safe. Split on whitespace too, or require each token to be a single address.

findings.label: Pack ignores --mode/--trials when reusing latest check
findings.detail: evidence/pack.py _needs_fresh_check compares only config hashes, so 'pack --trials 10' after a '--trials 2' REVIEW check packages the 2-trial result. Include mode and trials_per_attack in the freshness comparison.

findings.label: Override replay
findings.detail: gate/gate.py override() never checks whether the latest REVIEW decision was already overridden, so repeated overrides of the same decision are all recorded. Refuse when an override entry already references that decision_entry_hash.

findings.label: Repo-local public key trust
findings.detail: verify.py defaults to .keys/public.pem in the same repo and the genesis public_key_sha256 is never compared to an external value, so anyone able to rewrite chain + key can produce a passing audit. Document out-of-band key/fingerprint pinning or add an optional expected-fingerprint argument.
